owner.name: Chris
owner.about: Runs WeScale Marketing and manages sales for Circle of Greatness (COG): 10-15 closers and setters who post EOD KPIs in Slack, with appointments in GoHighLevel. Also runs a peptide business. Motto for the team: AI watches everything, Chris manages the exceptions. Talk to him in plain English: answer first, short, one decision at a time. All times in Eastern (ET).

reserved.name: Peptide Operator
reserved.note: Created later by Ops with Chris after the peptide intake (milestone M10), in its own workspace 'Peptide' (separate memory and logins, per the Oct 16 call). Not created at install.

routines.title: Daily team health check
routines.goal: Run the team-health-check skill (daily part): confirm each enabled routine ran, do a cheap read of every configured source (EOD source, KPI channel history, GHL appointments, calendars, Gmail, Drive), count approvals waiting. Send Chief one line; details only for failures. A source you cannot read is 'unknown', never fine. Change nothing without Chris's OK.

routines.title: Weekly team review
routines.goal: Run the team-health-check skill (weekly part): routine reliability, sources that were down, model usage per bot, access review vs each charter, one improvement proposal with evidence. Under 200 words to Chief. Propose changes; do not make them.

routines.title: EOD first check (23:30 ET)
routines.goal: Run the cog-eod-compliance skill as the FIRST check for today's selling day, using config/cog.json. If anything required is missing reply NO_CLIENT_SOURCE and stop. Post the bump only if bump.standing_approval_recorded is true, exactly from template_first, in the configured KPI channel; otherwise send Chris the draft to approve. Never bump if the source was unreadable. Log to the vault.

routines.title: EOD final check before cutoff
routines.goal: Run the cog-eod-compliance skill as the FINAL check for the selling day that just ended (before the configured cutoff). Mark anyone still missing as eod_missing and late submitters as eod_late in their rep notes. Bump with template_final under the same rules as the first check. DM Chris the final compliance summary.

routines.title: Morning sales report
routines.goal: Run the cog-daily-sales-report skill for the previous selling day: reported vs verified numbers, discrepancies, disposition/calendar/no-show findings, attention list with evidence links, source status. Save to the vault daily note and send the short version to Chief. Unknown sources are shown as unknown, never as zero.

routines.title: No-show sweep 12:00
routines.goal: Run the cog-no-show-audit skill for appointments that ended since the previous sweep (or since 00:00 ET). DM Chris only if there are violations, grouped in one message. If you can schedule one-time checks, schedule today's remaining appointment checks at start + the SOP window.

routines.title: No-show sweep 15:00
routines.goal: Run the cog-no-show-audit skill for appointments that ended since the previous sweep. DM Chris only if there are violations, grouped in one message.

routines.title: No-show sweep 18:00
routines.goal: Run the cog-no-show-audit skill for appointments that ended since the previous sweep. DM Chris only if there are violations, grouped in one message.

routines.title: No-show sweep 21:00
routines.goal: Run the cog-no-show-audit skill for appointments that ended since the previous sweep. DM Chris only if there are violations, grouped in one message.

routines.title: Weekly review + scorecards
routines.goal: Run the cog-weekly-review skill (which runs cog-rep-scorecard) for the week that just ended: team trends, scorecards lowest first with evidence, recurring problems, attention-vs-automate lists, source health, three decisions for Chris. Save to the vault, send under 250 words to Chief and Chris; send automatable items to Growth Operator or Ops.

routines.title: Morning command brief
routines.goal: Run the chief-command-brief skill: up to five 'Needs you' items with links and ready actions, COG headline numbers from the 08:00 report, today's calendar, approvals waiting, pre-call prep status, team health. Under 200 words to Chris. If a teammate has not reported, say so; never fill in their numbers.

routines.title: Friday wrap
routines.goal: Run the chief-command-brief skill in Friday-wrap mode: the week's wins, misses, decisions made (vault Decisions.md), open decisions, top 3 for next week. Under 200 words.

routines.title: Weekly call review -> asset backlog
routines.goal: Run the call-review-to-assets skill on the last 7 days of calls plus the COG weekly review, update the asset backlog, start the top 1-3 assets with sales-asset-builder as Google Doc drafts, and send Chris a summary under 150 words. Nothing is published or shared.

routines.title: Booked calls: briefs + sequences (morning)
routines.goal: Run the precall-indoctrination-sequence skill for appointments in the next 72 hours without a brief: profile, pick content, draft the timed sequence and the one-page closer brief. Send Chris one batch to approve. Never message a prospect without approval.

routines.title: New bookings sweep (midday)
routines.goal: Run the precall-indoctrination-sequence skill for appointments booked since the morning run. Draft only; batch for Chris's approval.

routines.title: Weekly money check-in
routines.goal: Run the monthly-cash-flow-report skill: the weekly check-in, and on the first Sunday of the month also the monthly report. Use only the read-only exports and ledger Chris set up; a missing export means that account is unknown. Never move money or store account numbers.

routine_preamble: Playbook first: through the Google Drive connection, read {skill_files} and {root}/Config/cog.json (the CFO has no config file). Any package path a playbook mentions (skills/, charters/, docs/, policies/) is under {root}/Playbooks/, and any other skill it names is at {root}/Playbooks/skills/<name>/SKILL.md. Every 'vault/...' path means the Drive folder '{root}/...': write notes there as plain-text .md files, never Google Docs. Times are Eastern: check the real ET time first; if it is more than 20 minutes from this routine's ET time, post nothing outward, send Chris drafts only, and tell Ops the clock has drifted. If you cannot read the playbook, reply NO_CLIENT_SOURCE: playbook unreadable, and stop.
notes: Every routine is created PAUSED. Enable them per INSTALL.md step 9 after the intake and the dry run.

Routine times are Eastern. The installer converts them to the app server's own clock (state.instance.timezone). If that clock does not follow US daylight saving (for example UTC-5 all year), the installer warns and `--retime` re-fits the times after each change.
Weekly 'day' uses 0=Sunday ... 6=Saturday, as in the app.
Canonical files live in Google Drive: 'GrokBot Vault' (business: Playbooks/, Config/cog.json, notes) and 'GrokBot Personal' (CFO only). scripts/sync-drive.mjs puts them there.
